There are no shell command substitutions, subshells, or external execution calls at the top level that could introduce malicious code. The `source` URL is stored as a string value and is not fetched during this operation. Since `--printsrcinfo` only reads the file and extracts its metadata, no dangerous code can be executed. The presence of a SHA256 checksum (not skipped) further confirms the file integrity is maintained.
</details>
